name: MA Trend
summary: This EA trades based on moving average trend direction, entering long positions when price is above the MA and short positions when below. It uses a single moving average as the primary trend filter and executes trades on trend confirmation signals. The strategy is a classic trend-following system with straightforward entry and exit rules based on MA crossovers or price-MA relationship.
summary_zh: 该EA基于均线趋势方向进行交易，价格在均线上方时做多，下方时做空。使用单一均线作为主要趋势过滤器，在趋势确认信号时执行交易。该策略是经典的趋势跟踪系统，入场和出场规则基于均线交叉或价格与均线的关系。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用单一均线判断趋势方向，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为价格突破均线向上时开多单，价格跌破均线向下时开空单。出场条件通常为价格反向穿越均线时平仓，或设置固定止损止盈。仓位管理方面，默认使用固定手数下单，缺乏基于波动率或账户余额的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理较为简单，没有复合仓位或马丁格尔机制，但也没有严格的资金保护措施。整体策略逻辑清晰但单一，缺乏多维度确认和过滤机制，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses a single moving average to determine trend direction, representing a classic trend-following strategy. Entry conditions trigger a long position when price breaks above the MA and a short position when price breaks below the MA. Exit conditions typically close positions when price reverses across the MA, or through fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing relies on a fixed lot size by default, lacking dynamic adjustment based on volatility or account equity. Money management is relatively simple with no compounding or martingale mechanisms, but also lacks stringent capital protection measures. The overall strategy logic is clear but singular, lacking multi-dimensional confirmation and filtering mechanisms, making it prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses during ranging markets.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和维护
趋势行情中表现良好，能够捕捉中长期趋势
无马丁格尔或网格机制，不会出现指数级亏损风险
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and maintain
Performs well in trending markets, capable of capturing medium-to-long-term trends
No martingale or grid mechanism, avoiding exponential loss risk
cons: 单一均线判断趋势，震荡行情中频繁虚假信号
缺乏多时间框架确认和成交量过滤
固定手数下单，未根据市场波动率动态调整仓位
cons_en: Single MA for trend determination generates frequent false signals in ranging markets
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation and volume filtering
Fixed lot sizing without dynamic adjustment based on market volatility
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认，例如大周期趋势过滤后再在小周期入场
加入ATR动态止损和仓位管理，根据市场波动率调整风险敞口
增加震荡行情过滤器（如ADX或布林带宽度），避免在盘整期频繁交易
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., filter with higher timeframe trend before entering on lower timeframe
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and position sizing to adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
Add ranging market filters (such as ADX or Bollinger Band width) to avoid frequent trading during consolidation periods

risk_points: 单一指标策略在震荡市中容易产生连续亏损
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线反复开仓
默认止损止盈为零，依赖反向信号平仓存在较大风险敞口
risk_points_en: Single indicator strategy prone to consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lacks new bar check mechanism, may repeatedly open positions on the same bar
Default stop-loss and take-profit set to zero, relying on reversal signals for exit exposes significant risk
